# Publish and qualify protected browser ABI

Depends on #826 and #827 PASS/upstream. #825's native owner, additive records/queries/receipts, private protected staged boot, Unsupported guards and protected stream start/stop are a pushed baseline, but #825 is stopped/superseded for attempt accounting. This issue owns one closable publication outcome: expose public protected boot after all alias transactions are verified, generate the complete additive ABI layout/export vocabulary from Rust, refresh the checked-in SDK ABI assets, and qualify one actual shipped simd128 AudioWorklet Wasm artifact with scalar Wasm cargo-check evidence. Browser receiver/sender/subscription/app behavioral adoption is a later issue.

## Scope and frozen contract

Allowed production: `hosts/host-web/src/ffi.rs` (public boot forwarding the existing private transaction and, for checkpoint C only, replacement of existing inline observation numeric literals with shared Rust constants without control-flow changes) and minimal `hosts/host-web/src/lib.rs` visibility/shared constants needed by the generator and runtime; `tools/parameter-metadata/src/abi_layout.rs` and existing layout tests; `scripts/check-abi-layout-v1.py`, `scripts/fixtures/abi-layout-v1-self-test.json`, `scripts/check-web-audioworklet.sh` and their existing self-tests; the normal source-derived generated `sdk/assets/miso-engine-v1-abi-layout.json`, `sdk/src/generated/abi.ts`/provenance; one narrow generated-offset BigInt fixture in `sdk/test/browser-evals.mjs` and one actual-artifact boot/layout fixture in `sdk/test/boot-evals.mjs`; the existing source-derived artifact hash pin. The SDK declaration mirror currently matches its shipped source byte-for-byte and is outside this issue unless a concrete publication need identifies and justifies edits to **both** `hosts/host-web/web/miso-engine-v1-audio-worklet-host.d.ts` and `sdk/src/browser/shipped-host.d.ts`. No new generator, general SDK reader cleanup, benchmarking framework, JS worklet receiver/sender behavior, subscription owner, app/frontend, FFT or second artifact.

Public `miso_engine_web_v1_boot_with_observation_demand(len)` forwards the already tested private protected boot transaction and cannot fall back to Legacy on malformed nested headers, reserved fields, padded target IDs or explicit limits. Preserve every old C-ABI record size, numeric result, exported spelling and symbol. Generate all eight additive observation record layouts, every nested leaf via summed actual Rust `offset_of!`, and explicit non-semantic alignment-padding byte rows derived from adjacent offsets. The independent Python validator enforces the exact structure/field/type/export vocabulary and complete nonoverlapping tiling; padding is `u8[4]` and nonsemantic, with no required zero value. Generate the lexically sorted union of all old exports with the 16 currently unlisted additive Rust exports and public protected boot (17 additions), plus canonical profile/operation/domain/state/flag/refusal vocabulary derived from runtime authorities; no hand-written JavaScript offsets. Generate checked-in JSON/TypeScript once at a coherent boundary through existing tooling. The Wasm module's actual exports/layouts must agree with generated metadata and the pinned artifact bytes.

Checkpoint C freezes the additive vocabulary as separate lower-camel named groups, with exactly these name/value rows: `observationProfiles` = `legacyUnprotected` 0, `eqSpectrum` 1; `observationOperations` = `replaceMeters` 1, `removeMetersTo` 2, `stopGraph` 3, `startSpectrum` 4, `restartSpectrum` 5, `readSpectrum` 6, `stopSpectrum` 7, `captureResponse` 8, `rawObservationBatch` 9, `oneShot` 10, `collectionSelection` 11, `meterLease` 12, `meterRead` 13, `residentRead` 14; `observationReceiptDomains` = `graph` 1, `resident` 2; `observationReceiptStates` = `pending` 1, `applied` 2, `closed` 3, `failed` 4; `observationAdmissionFlags` = `receiptPresent` 1, `requestedPresent` 2, `maximumPresent` 4, `pendingBoundary` 8; `observationStatusFlags` = `ordinaryAvailable` 1, `removalAvailable` 2, `terminal` 4, `renderFailed` 8; `observationCaptureKinds` = `response` 1, `spectrum` 2; `observationCaptureFlags` = `graphGeneration` 1; `observationRefusalReasons` = `none` 0, `notPrepared` 1, `wrongOwner` 2, `capacity` 3, `workBudget` 4, `backpressure` 5, `conflict` 6, `closed` 7, `invalidRequest` 8, `arithmeticOverflow` 9, `revisionExhausted` 10. Frozen unsupported rows describe wire vocabulary, not executable V1 capability. Wire profile 1 must not be inferred from `WebObservationProfile::EqSpectrum as u32` (which is 0); refusal codes must not be inferred from native enum discriminants. Zero for profile/refusal is meaningful; zero for receipt domain/state and capture kind is an empty sentinel. Requested/maximum presence follows flag bits even when their values are zero.

Serial C checkpoints: C1 adds only the 17 FFI-source-confirmed public exports to the generator, Python exact list, frozen shell `expected_exports` list and generated self-test fixture, preserving 114 old names and `memory` only in the shell. C2a publishes profiles/operations using shared runtime constants; it may use one smaller green host-source authority tranche (`lib.rs`/`ffi.rs` shared constants and symbolic substitutions, locked host suite) followed by one green metadata-publication tranche (generator/Rust test/Python/fixture), with a root exact-path commit/push between them. C2b publishes receipt domains/states, admission/status flags and capture kinds/flags; it may use the same host-source/metadata split, with the host tranche limited to public shared constants and replacing the existing Response-kind literal. C2c publishes refusal reasons through the existing native-to-wire mapping; it may use a smaller `lib.rs`-only source-mapping/constant tranche before generator/Rust test/Python/fixture publication. Each completed C2 slice updates the generator, focused Rust test, Python exact schema and regenerated fixture together and must pass the complete coupled layout suite/validator before the next starts. For C2c, `parameter-metadata` has `host-core` only as a dev dependency: publish authoritative host-web wire constants through its existing refusal mapping (make the mapping `const` if needed), without adding a production dependency or casting native enum discriminants. No numeric value or runtime behavior changes. An independent adversarial review of the C split returned GO before C implementation; the narrower source/metadata tranches keep the same finished contract and gates.

## Objective gates

- Actual public protected boot → Pending spectrum start → real Applied application receipt → nonzero raw PCM and response capture with matching native identities → reserved/repeated stop → terminal status/application handoff; malformed exact/one-below budgets and nested header/reserved/ID cases refuse without Legacy fallback. Preserve legacy boot. Native lifecycle fixtures use the public boot function and existing direct staging helpers; native `pointer_u32` may return zero for an address above `u32`, so actual exported pointer/layout evidence uses the Wasm module.
- Source-derived records decode actual Rust widths/offsets, including nested leaves and the real ingress alignment hole at bytes 28–31 (also preparation bytes 164–167). Preparation flattens work, ingress and spectrum-request leaves; admission flattens receipt leaves without overlapping aggregate rows. `u64` owner/generation/selection/token/limit and nested receipt values above `2^53` round-trip exactly through generated offsets/BigInt, using distinct odd and near-maximum values. Old records/constants/exports remain byte-for-byte and numerically unchanged. Validator self-test red mutations catch missing fields, wrong same-width types, bad padding, nested-field mistakes and missing exports; focused Rust field lookup stays bounded to its selected structure when field names repeat.
- Locked native check and focused/full host-web tests; parameter-metadata generator `--check`; SDK generated/layout/type gates; wasm32 scalar cargo check and simd128 cargo check/build; actual artifact export/layout/opcode/callgraph/resource gate with one source-derived regenerated hash pin; proportional realtime/allocation gate; format/diff. Use `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/home/bl/misofm/engine/target`. Do not retry/tune descriptive benchmarks.

## Delivery and evidence record

At most four coherent issue-wide implementation rounds: fresh Luna MAX rounds 1–2, Sol HIGH round 3 if needed, Astra XHIGH round 4 if needed. Each gets one independent fresh Astra MEDIUM adversarial verdict; fixture-only revisions count. After round four FAIL, stop and rebrief. Each fresh implementer receives a small compiling, testable scope with only this stateless issue and exact source pointers; root commits each exact-path green or candid useful recovery tranche before layering another and synchronizes pushed evidence/GitHub. A round's adversarial verdict assesses the coherent candidate for this publication contract; checkpoint letters cannot reset its attempt ledger. Record hashes, source/export/layout hash and generated diff, actual Wasm artifact hash/gate output, lifecycle/BigInt fixtures, exact commands/results, reviewer verdict and remaining findings here. If behavioral SDK/browser wiring becomes required, split it immediately into the adoption issue rather than expanding this contract.

Decision/evidence: round 1 PASS after one fresh independent Astra MEDIUM issue-wide adversarial verdict; public protected browser ABI and the pinned simd128 artifact are locally qualified and upstream. GitHub closure and merged delivery follow this verdict checkpoint; app/browser behavioral adoption remains successor scope.
